text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting authorization to close the north sidewalk and north curb lane on Eastern Avenue and also the west sidewalk and southbound curb lane abutting the site on Logan Ave for a period of 28 months. 462 Developments Inc. is building an eight-storey condominium with a total of 286 units, with a two level underground basement parking. The site is located on the north side of Eastern Avenue, west side of Logan Avenue and east-side of Booth Avenue. To enable construction, the applicant requires the aforementioned closures.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the closure of the north sidewalk and westbound curb lane of Eastern Avenue, from the west side of Logan Avenue to the eastside of Booth Avenue, from December 2, 2019 to March 31, 2022. 2. Authorized the closure of the west sidewalk and 1.7 metre portion of the southbound lane on Logan Avenue from Eastern Avenue and a point 90 metres further north, from December 2, 2019 to March 31, 2022. 3. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the north side of Eastern Avenue, from Logan Avenue to Booth Avenue. 4. Rescinded the existing stopping prohibition in effect from 7:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m., Monday to Friday, except public holidays, on the north side of Eastern Avenue, from Booth Avenue to Logan Avenue. 5. Prohibited stopping at all times on the north side of Eastern Avenue, from Logan Avenue to Booth Avenue.…
